name: WorkBuddy

mcp.note: WorkBuddy keeps MCP servers in its own store (workbuddy.db plus the mcp-tool-list.json / mcp-approvals.json caches), not in a JSON file: add agent-memory-hub from its MCP or connector manager, then trust it there.

verify: Verified: ~/.workbuddy/memory/ holds per-user profile files named <uuid>_memory.md (a Memory Block plus a RAW_JSON_START block), not MEMORY.md or CODEBUDDY.md, so the project-level target above only applies if WorkBuddy is used inside a repo.

There is no .mcp.json or mcp.json under ~/.workbuddy - only mcp-tool-list.json (a tool cache) and mcp-approvals.json - so the JSON registration mode does not apply and MCP is set up in the UI instead.
The native profile files carry a UUID name, so they cannot be registered as a static import source: run `amh import --file ~/.workbuddy/memory/<uuid>_memory.md --global` once if you want those facts.
Keep the managed block short: its own docs advise ~10-20 memory items.
